skill.name: kuaishou-topic-analysis
skill.description: Analyze Kuaishou trending topics and keyword search samples through SocialDataX to support short-video topic planning.
skill.summary: Turn Kuaishou trends and traceable video samples into evidence-based topic ideas.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One finding confirms unpinned npm package execution with potential access to the configured API key; 38 findings are false positives. Other matches reflect Markdown, provider links, legitimate authentication guidance, and readable Chinese text. No evidence found of credential exfiltration or prompt injection in the reviewed files; external package behavior was not inspected.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a fixed dependency version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed release, verify package provenance and integrity, and obtain consent before executing downloaded code with the API key available.

content.user_title: Analyze Kuaishou Trends for Video Topic Planning
content.value_statement: Planning short videos requires relevant trend signals and traceable examples. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and separates observed evidence from suggested content angles.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of Kuaishou hot-search rankings and available heat signals through the SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tool.
Search Kuaishou video samples using focused keywords.
Control retrieval using page limits, item limits, and opaque continuation tokens.
Organize available titles, authors, content IDs, share links, and visible engagement metrics for traceable analysis.
Separate observed evidence from suggested topic angles and follow-up questions.
Handle partial results and resume searches while preserving cumulative retrieval limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and available service balance; direct CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.
Search results are samples, not an exhaustive Kuaishou dataset; available fields depend on provider responses.
The workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.
CLI examples run an unpinned external npm package; its implementation is not included in this skill.

use_cases.title: Plan creator topics
use_cases.description: Compare trending searches with relevant video samples to choose evidence-supported content angles.

use_cases.title: Research brand conversations
use_cases.description: Search brand-related keywords and retain source links, author facts, and visible metrics for team review.

use_cases.title: Build an editorial shortlist
use_cases.description: Collect a bounded sample, group promising angles, and identify follow-up questions for the next planning session.

prompt_templates.title: Review current trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Kuaishou hot-search list. Summarize available rankings and heat signals, separating observed facts from topic suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Search a focused topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [keyword] using one page. List relevant titles, authors, links or IDs, and three evidence-based topic angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect a small keyword sample.

prompt_templates.title: Compare audience angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [keyword A] and [keyword B], limiting each to 10 items. Compare visible evidence and propose angles for [audience].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare two bounded topic samples.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a partial research sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the partial [keyword] search using its complete returned token. Preserve the original three-page, 30-item limits and identify remaining evidence gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover an interrupted search without restarting.

output_examples.input: Show how a Kuaishou topic shortlist would be presented.
output: Illustrative format only; no live retrieval is represented.
Evidence: topic name, returned ranking, available heat signal, and supporting video references.
Interpretation: explain why each sample fits the topic and identify an angle to test.
Next question: narrow the audience or scenario before expanding the sample.

output_examples.input: Explain how to report an interrupted keyword search.
output: Illustrative status: the search returned partial results and an error; coverage is incomplete.
Retain retrieved items and the error message. Resume only with a nonempty returned continuation token after resolving the issue.
Deduct collected pages and items from the original limits. Do not automatically restart from page one.

best_practices: Start with one page and focused keywords; expand only within explicit page and item limits.
Retain source IDs and links, and label interpretations separately from visible evidence.
Use a reviewed CLI release, keep API keys private, and confirm authorization before dependency changes or paid requests.
anti_patterns: Treating a small search sample or heat signal as proof of platform-wide demand or guaranteed video success.
Rewriting continuation tokens, ignoring cumulative limits, or restarting partial searches automatically.
Sharing API keys in prompts or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.

faq.question: What access do I need?
faq.answer: You need a SocialDataX API key, network access, and available balance. Direct CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm.

faq.question: Do I need an MCP server?
faq.answer: No. The skill prioritizes direct CLI commands and also documents corresponding MCP tools when those tools are already available.

faq.question: Does this skill publish or modify my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Can I retrieve every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete boundary and does not support --all. Use explicit page or item limits.

faq.question: What happens when a request returns partial results?
faq.answer: Keep the results and error. Resume with the complete returned token when available, preserving the original cumulative limits.

faq.question: What should I do when my balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop retries and review the official SocialDataX billing page. After funding the correct account, resume according to the documented recovery rules.
